title: Smart Data Models - ERA RINF - Body
description: Body (era:Body's own definition, verbatim, in the source ontology): Is an organisation or a physical person

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'Body'

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification.

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the source of the entity data.

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.

alternativeCode.description: Property. Alternative code resulting of the integration of RISC into SRMO for managing organisation code

faxNumber.description: Property. Fax number of a body.

organisationSize.description: Property. The size of a given organisation or body. Controlled-vocabulary value: IRI of a skos:Concept from ERA's 'Organisation sizes' SKOS concept scheme (http://data.europa.eu/949/concepts/org-size/OrgSizes), 4 concepts, enumerated below from era-skos.

role.description: Relationship. Indicates the relationship of a Body to the organisation roles that it can play.
